title: maria-santos-people-ops-self-notes-manager-prep
content:
Manager prep + self-notes (Q4 2025 -> Q1 2026)

Purpose:
- Quick notes for 1:1 and calibration cycle.
- Capture key wins, metrics, development areas, and asks for manager.

Top-of-mind wins (concise):
- Standardized new-hire onboarding checklist and role-specific playbooks for SRE/Serving Runtime hires. Rolled out Nov 2025.
  - Impact: reduced new hire time-to-productivity (internally measured ramp score) from ~6 weeks -> ~4.5 weeks on average in pilot teams (eng + infra).
  - Next: expand to Console and Solutions Eng onboarding by end of Q2 2026.
- Launched Offer Pack playbook with Legal/Finance -> reduced offer turnaround time from 6.5 days to ~3.2 days for technical IC offers.
- Led performance calibration rubric pilot with Product & Eng leads (Dec 2025). Created 4 anchor examples for L2-L4 ICs. Feedback loop: managers appreciated anchor examples but asked for more cross-functional examples.

Metrics & signals to highlight:
- New hire ramp improvement (pilot teams): -25% time-to-productivity.
- Offer acceptance rate (technical roles) moved from 68% -> 74% (Dec–Feb).
- Hiring velocity: reduced average time-to-offer by ~3 days after playbook.
- 1:1 sentiment (pulse) baseline: 74% positive -> target 80% by Q3.

STAR examples for performance conversation:
- Situation: multiple SRE and Serving Runtime roles open in ramp up for Dedicated product.
- Task: improve hiring throughput without sacrificing quality while working with limited recruiter headcount.
- Action: introduced targeted hiring scorecards, run-charts for pipeline, and weekly hiring triage with Eng hiring managers + recruiters; created shortlist templates to speed feedback loops.
- Result: time-to-offer down 3 days; acceptance rate up ~6 points in two months.

Development areas / honest notes:
- Need to be more proactive about cross-functional storytelling: make the tie between people work and product / revenue outcomes explicit in deck one-pagers.
- I sometimes overbuild process before validating with managers (leaner experiments first).
- Delegation: still own too many onboarding doc edits myself. Goal: identify one deputy for content maintenance by end of Q2.

Requests for manager (Ethan):
- Priority guidance: which 2 playbooks should I prioritize for expansion in H1? My current bet: Console + Solutions Eng (highest perceived onboarding pain).
- Headcount ask timing: advocate for +1 recruiter for Q3 hiring surge (we have data showing pipeline drop if recruiter capacity not increased).
- Feedback: would appreciate direct feedback on my cross-functional narratives — can we do one calibration prep run-through together before Exec review?

Career / growth note:
- Interested in a people partner role that blends talent strategy + product GTM support (help product teams shape org design as product scales). Open to a path toward Senior People Partner or manager of a small people-ops program team in ~12–18 months.
- Would like stretch assignment owning the technical recruiting roadmap for one quarter to demonstrate program management impact.

Open questions / to-do:
- Compile a 1-pager with before/after metrics for onboarding playbook (for Exec review) — draft by Mar 15.
- Get anonymized feedback from 6 hiring managers about the new scorecard (ask Olivia to run).
- Align with Finance on offer approval workflow automation timeline (linked JIRA: JIRA-HR-134).

Quick notes to copy into 1:1:
- Key ask: short-term: decision on prioritization of playbooks (Console vs Solutions Eng).
- Mid-term: support on recruiter hire (data packet prepared).
- Feedback ask: clarity on how to present people metrics to Product leadership (format/level of detail).

Rough timeline / milestones:
- Mar 15: onboarding playbook metrics 1-pager.
- Apr 30: identify deputy for onboarding docs.
- Jun 30: pilot Console onboarding expansion completed.

Misc (notes to self):
- Keep evidence log: save before/after ramp data in confluence page CONFLUENCE-people-ops-onboarding-2025.
- Keep manager loop small: only escalate blockers that will impact offers/hiring velocity.
- Remember: highlight customer impact (eng teams ship features faster because ramp < 5 weeks) — connects to Redwood mission (shipping LLM features reliably).

End of doc.
